headline: Tesla Robotaxi Moving to 24/7 Service: AI Chief Confirms Round-the-Clock Rollout Soon
reason: This marks a significant L4 operational milestone for Tesla's autonomous driving technology, as the company's AI Chief confirmed the impending transition to 24/7 unsupervised robotaxi service, building on the fleet's accumulation of over one million incident-free autonomous miles. This move expands the commercial viability and functional deployment of autonomous vehicles, pushing the industry closer to widespread L4 adoption.
